title: EC2 compute (instances, scaling, storage, networking) — concept map
intro: EC2 delivers resizable compute in your VPC. You launch from Amazon Machine Images (AMIs), attach Elastic Network Interfaces (ENIs) for networking, scale with Auto Scaling Groups (ASGs), persist data on Elastic Block Store (EBS) or accept ephemeral instance store, and debug connectivity with a layered checklist.

overviewDiagram.title: EC2 in a VPC
overviewDiagram.source:
flowchart TB
  AMI[AMI / Launch template] --> EC2[EC2 instance]
  subgraph VPC
    EC2 --> ENI[Primary ENI in subnet]
    EC2 --> EBS[EBS root + data volumes]
    ASG[Auto Scaling Group] --> EC2
  end
  ENI --> RT[Route table + SG]
  RT --> ALB[ALB / Internet]

conceptCards.title: Instances & AMIs
conceptCards.summary: Instance type = CPU/RAM/network profile. AMI = bootable template. Launch templates version infra.
conceptCards.example: t3.medium from Amazon Linux 2023 AMI in private subnet

conceptCards.title: ENI attachment
conceptCards.summary: Every instance has a primary ENI in a subnet. Secondary ENIs for multi-homing or Lambda.
conceptCards.example: Move ENI to standby instance for fast failover

conceptCards.title: Auto Scaling
conceptCards.summary: ASG maintains desired capacity across AZs using health checks and scaling policies.
conceptCards.example: Target tracking on ALB request count per target

conceptCards.title: EBS vs instance store
conceptCards.summary: EBS persists across stop/start; instance store is local NVMe, lost on stop/terminate.
conceptCards.example: gp3 root volume + io2 for database on EC2

conceptCards.title: Networking troubleshoot
conceptCards.summary: Check SG, NACL, route table, ENI, public IP, and OS firewall in order.
conceptCards.example: VPC Reachability Analyzer for path proof
